body:
4 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

The stories:

Road closures for Norden Christmas lights event on 22 November 2026 (Norden). Norden will see road closures on 22 November 2026 for the Christmas lights event, affecting local traffic and access.

Man in his 60s injured in flat fire on Baguley Crescent, Middleton (Middleton). Emergency services, including an air ambulance, responded to a flat fire in Middleton, injuring a man in his 60s.

Remembrance walkers cover 22 miles and eight cenotaphs to raise money for veterans (Rochdale). Get Together After Serving walkers paid their respects at cenotaphs from Norden to Rochdale, with the Mayor joining them at Milnrow.

Rochdale battalion's sacrifices during the First World War remembered (Rochdale). The 6th Battalion, Lancashire Fusiliers, faced heavy losses in battles against the Ottomans and Germans, contributing to the Allied victory in World War I.
